summary: Automatic updates never move an environment to an older version, and the ring you choose is the ring you get.

fixes.title: Updates never go backward
fixes.text: The nightly update refuses to move an environment to an older version and names both versions. A deliberate rollback must be switched on for that environment.

fixes.title: Your chosen ring is applied and verified
fixes.text: The update ring you choose at installation is now used and checked after deployment, instead of a default ring.
fixes.action: If an environment has been running on a ring you did not intend, re-run the deployment naming the ring you want.

fixes.title: Clearer setup and edition documentation
fixes.text: The README describes the six supported setups, explains the release ring versus the replication ring, and sets out the Community and Pro editions.
